verses.text: Jacob overheard Laban’s sons saying, “Jacob has hauled off everything Dad had. All this wealth he’s showing came from our father’s stuff!” 🗣️
Jacob could read the room: Laban’s face wasn’t friendly toward him like before. 👀
Yahweh told Jacob, “It’s time to return to your fathers’ land and your relatives. I’ll be with you.” 🧭
Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah to meet him out in the field with his flock. 🐑
He said, “I can see your father’s whole vibe toward me has changed. But my father’s God has been with me. 🙏
You both know I put all my strength into serving your father. 💪
Your father played games with my wages—he changed them ten times—but God didn’t let him harm me. ⚖️

If he said, ‘The speckled animals will be your wages,’ then the whole flock produced speckled young. If he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then the whole flock produced streaked young. 🐑
That’s how God shifted your father’s livestock over to me. 🐐
During mating season, I looked up in a dream and saw the male goats jumping on the flock were streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted. 🐐
The angel of God called my name in the dream: ‘Jacob!’ I answered, ‘I’m here.’ 🌙
He said, ‘Look up—see all those male goats jumping on the flock? Streaked, speckled, gray-spotted. I’ve seen everything Laban has been doing to you. 👀
I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and made a vow to me. Now get up, leave this land, and head back to your birthplace.’” 🪨
Rachel and Leah answered him, “So what’s left for us in our father’s house—any share, any inheritance? 🤔
Doesn’t he treat us like outsiders? He sold us and burned through the money that should’ve been ours. 😠
All the wealth God took from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God told you.” ✅
Jacob got moving, loading his sons and wives onto camels. 🐪
He took all his livestock and everything he’d gathered in Paddan Aram, heading back to his father Isaac in Canaan. 🧳
While Laban was away shearing his sheep, Rachel secretly took her father’s household idols. 👀
Jacob made his getaway without telling Laban the Syrian he was running off. 🤫
He escaped with everything he had, crossed the River, and headed for the mountains of Gilead. 🧭
On the third day, Laban was told that Jacob had fled. 📣
He gathered his relatives and chased Jacob for seven days before catching up with him in the mountains of Gilead. 🏃
That night, God appeared to Laban the Syrian in a dream: “Watch your words with Jacob. Don’t say anything good or bad.” 🌙
Laban caught up with Jacob. Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains, and Laban and his relatives camped in the mountains of Gilead. ⛺
Laban confronted Jacob: “What have you done? You tricked me and took my daughters away like captives from a battle! 😠
Why the secret exit? Why trick me instead of telling me? I could’ve sent you off with a celebration—songs, tambourines, and harps! 🎶
You didn’t even let me kiss my sons and daughters goodbye. That was foolish. 😔
I could hurt you, but your father’s God spoke to me last night: ‘Watch your words with Jacob. Don’t say anything good or bad.’ ⚠️
You wanted to get back to your father’s house so badly—but why steal my gods?” 🤔
Jacob told Laban, “I was afraid. I thought you’d take your daughters from me by force. 😟
If you find your gods with anyone here, that person won’t live. In front of our relatives, check my things and take what’s yours.” Jacob didn’t know Rachel had taken them. 🔍
Laban searched Jacob’s tent, Leah’s tent, and the tents of the two servants, but found nothing. He left Leah’s tent and checked Rachel’s. 🔍
Rachel had tucked the idols into the camel’s saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched the whole tent, but couldn’t find them. 🐪
She said to her father, “Please don’t be angry that I can’t stand up for you; I’m having my period.” He searched, but still didn’t find the idols. 🗣️
Jacob’s anger finally boiled over. He argued with Laban: “What have I done wrong? What sin did I commit that you chased me down like this? 😠
You’ve gone through all my stuff. What did you find that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of our relatives and let them judge between us. ⚖️
I’ve been with you 20 years. Your ewes and female goats never lost their young, and I never ate the rams from your flock. 🐑
When wild animals tore one apart, I didn’t bring it to you—I absorbed the loss myself. You charged me for anything stolen by day or night. 🐺
This was my everyday: heat wearing me down by day, frost at night, sleep running from my eyes. ☀️
For 20 years I worked in your household: 14 years for your two daughters, six for your flocks. You changed my wages ten times. ⏳

If the God of my father—the God of Abraham, the One Isaac fears—hadn’t been with me, you would’ve sent me away with nothing. God saw my suffering and the work of my hands, and He rebuked you last night.” 🙏
Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are mine, the children are mine, the flocks are mine—everything you see is mine! What can I do today about my daughters and their children? 🤷
Come on, let’s make a covenant, you and me. Let it stand as a witness between us.” 🤝
Jacob picked up a stone and stood it upright as a pillar. 🪨
Jacob told his relatives, “Gather stones.” They gathered them into a heap, then ate there beside it. 🪨
Laban named the heap Jegar Sahadutha, while Jacob called it Galeed. 🗣️
Laban said, “This heap stands as a witness between us today.” That’s why it was named Galeed, 📍
and Mizpah, because he said, “May Yahweh keep watch between us when we’re far apart. 👀
If you mistreat my daughters or take more wives, even when no one else is around, remember: God is watching between us.” ⚖️
Laban said to Jacob, “Look at this heap and this pillar I’ve set up between us. 🪨
This heap and pillar are our witnesses: I won’t cross them to harm you, and you won’t cross them to harm me. 🤝
May the God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their father judge between us.” Jacob swore by the One his father Isaac revered. 🙏
Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountains and invited his relatives to eat. They shared bread and spent the night there. 🍽️
Early next morning, Laban got up, kissed his sons and daughters, blessed them, and headed back home. 🌅
